summary.text: Megan Wingfield, the Democratic nominee, is a mechanic from Bowling Green, Kentucky. Her campaign website describes her as a caregiver and activist who is running on working families, affordable healthcare and a fair shot for every Kentucky family.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, she was born and raised in Bowling Green, Kentucky.
Graduated from Southcentral Kentucky Community and Technical College (SKYCTC) with a degree in Automotive Technology and worked as a mechanic.
Her campaign website says she built her career as a mechanic and describes her as a caregiver and activist.

sources.title: Megan Wingfield for Congress | Kentucky's 2nd District
